D/ CONSTANTINVS IVN [NOB C] ; R/ PROVIDEN TIAE CAESS

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), Providentiae Caess issue of 324-330, Reece period 16, London mint, RIC volume 7 no. 296. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate and probably cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS IVN [NOB C]. Reverse description: Camp gate with two towers and no doors, star above. Reverse inscription: PROVIDEN TIAE CAESS. In exergue: PLON.…
